heading: Building Authority to give reasons
context:
Authorized Persons, Registered Structural Engineers, Registered Geotechnical
Engineers, Registered Inspectors and Registered
Contractors
content:
8E.
Building Authority to give reasons
The Building Authority is required to give reasons in writing for a decision not to include, retain or restore a contractor’s name in a register at the time of giving notice of the refusal.
(Added 54 of 1996 s. 9)
